latency_comparison: Six-process median complete Host ACK with process p10/p90 whiskers and individual process means; READ_ONLY is not search.
traffic_comparison: Mean all-kernel DRAM across32 queries in independent NCU diagnostics; whiskers are query p10/p90, not confidence intervals.
stage_survivors: Mean exact active population after each frozen checkpoint; shading is query p10/p90 and gray dots are all32 individual queries. The mean can exceed p90 because two queries have large outputs; this is not sampling confidence.
stage_time_breakdown: Separate event diagnostic phase walls split into measured scan/fields, measured CUB and host-phase residue; residue is not proven recoverable control.
